Neural Processes¶

Conditional Neural Process model for multi-asset implied-volatility surfaces, together with training, evaluation, and latent-space analytics.

Data¶

class neural_processes.data.base.SurfaceDataset(query_feats: ndarray, asset_ids: ndarray, targets: ndarray, split: ndarray, ctx_max: int, n_assets: int, params: ndarray | None = None, meta: dict = <factory>, bid: ndarray | None = None, ask: ndarray | None = None)[source]¶

Bases: object

Container for any surface-prediction dataset.

query_feats(N_days, N_points, Q_dim)

Query coordinates. Q_dim is flexible: 2 for (lm, T), more for exotic surfaces with extra features. meta[‘query_feat_names’] names each dim.

asset_ids : (N_days, N_points) int — 0-based

targets : (N_days, N_points) float — the thing being predicted (e.g. IV)

split : (N_days,) int8 — 0 = train, 1 = val

ctx_maxint — first ctx_max points per day are context candidates,

remaining points are target candidates

params : (N_days, N_assets, P_dim) optional ground-truth parameters

meta : arbitrary dict for DGP (data generating process) - specific metadata

neural_processes.data.heston.load_heston(train_path: str, ood_path: str | None = None, n_train_days: int | None = None, n_val_days: int | None = None, seed: int = 0) → tuple[SurfaceDataset, SurfaceDataset | None][source]¶

Parameters¶

train_path : path to heston_multiasset_training.npz ood_path : optional path to heston_multiasset_ood_test.npz n_train_days : subsample this many training days (None = use all) n_val_days : subsample this many validation days (None = use all) seed : RNG seed for subsampling

neural_processes.data.grouptech.load_grouptech(csv_path: str, n_train_days: int | None = None, n_val_days: int | None = None, seed: int = 0, val_frac: float = 0.15, assets: list[str] | None = None, ctx_frac: float = 0.6, iv_max: float = 3.0) → SurfaceDataset[source]¶

Load Group Tech US options data from CSV into a SurfaceDataset.

Only call options with a positive bid are used. Dates where any of the configured assets has no data are dropped so every training day has a complete, consistent set of assets.

Parameters¶

csv_path : path to group_tech_us.csv n_train_days: subsample this many training dates (None = use all) n_val_days : subsample this many validation dates (None = use all) seed : RNG seed for subsampling val_frac : fraction of dates held out for validation (chronological) assets : list of tickers to keep (default: all 10 group-tech assets) ctx_frac : fraction of points per day treated as context candidates iv_max : drop rows with IV above this threshold (removes deep-ITM outliers)

class neural_processes.models.cnp.MultiAssetCNP(n_assets: int, q_dim: int, d_asset: int = 8, d_model: int = 32, n_heads_obs: int = 4, n_layers_obs: int = 2, n_heads_cross: int = 4, n_layers_cross: int = 3, d_latent: int = 16, d_hidden: int = 128, n_hidden_dec: int = 3, dropout: float = 0.05)[source]¶

Bases: Module

Conditional Neural Process for multi-asset vol surfaces.

Encoder:

  1. ObsTransformer — all context observations (all assets mixed) attend to each other

  2. Per-asset mean pool → CrossAssetTransformer → per-asset latent codes

Decoder: z_asset || query_feats → MLP → target

class neural_processes.models.cnp.FittedCNP(module: MultiAssetCNP, feat_mean: ndarray, feat_std: ndarray, log_tgt_mean: ndarray, log_tgt_std: ndarray)[source]¶

Bases: SurfaceModel

Trained MultiAssetCNP with normalisation statistics, ready for analytics.

Targets are normalised as: y_n = (log(y) - log_tgt_mean[asset]) / log_tgt_std[asset] so predict() always returns raw IV values (not log-IV).

neural_processes.models.cnp.transfer_weights(src: MultiAssetCNP, dst: MultiAssetCNP) → int[source]¶

Copy all weights from src to dst, skipping asset_embed and prior which are n_assets-dependent. All shared transformer and decoder layers transfer directly because self-attention weight shapes are independent of sequence length. Returns the count of parameter tensors actually copied.

Analytics¶

neural_processes.analytics.reconstruction.eval_rmse_vs_ctx(model, dataset, indices, ctx_sizes, n_reps=8)[source]¶

RMSE (original IV units) on the target pool for each context size. Zero-padded positions (T == 0 in raw query_feats) are excluded from the mean.

neural_processes.analytics.reconstruction.eval_per_feature_rmse(model, dataset, indices, n_ctx=100, feat_dim=1, n_reps=6)[source]¶

RMSE broken down by unique values of one query feature (default dim 1 = maturity T). Zero-padded positions (T == 0) are excluded from both the bucket list and the mean.

neural_processes.analytics.reconstruction.eval_zeroshot(model, dataset, indices, n_ctx=50, n_reps=10)[source]¶

Per-asset RMSE when context excludes that asset (zero-shot) vs baseline. Zero-padded positions are excluded via a T > 0 validity mask. Returns {‘baseline’: array(A,), ‘zeroshot’: array(A,)}.

neural_processes.analytics.reconstruction.plot_call_reconstruction(model, dataset, day_idx, ctx_sizes=(5, 20, 50, 100), feat_dim_lm=0, feat_dim_T=1, out_path=None)[source]¶

Like plot_reconstruction but in forward-normalised call-price space.

Call prices are computed as bs_call_from_iv(iv, lm, T, forward=1, discount=1), giving C / (F * discount) — a purely (iv, lm, T)-driven quantity that strips out the absolute forward level and interest-rate effects.

Dashed lines = true quotes (converted from IV), solid lines = model predictions. Colours encode maturity T (same as plot_reconstruction).
